question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for:

 A person who studies ancient remains
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Archaeologist. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Archaeologist"** refers to a person who studies human history and prehistory through the excavation of sites, analysis of artifacts, and other physical remains. (पुरातत्त्ववेत्ता) • **Example:** The archaeologist discovered ancient pottery during the excavation. **Explanation of the correct word:** • An **Archaeologist** is a specialist in archaeology, which is the study of ancient cultures and civilizations through material remains. (पुरातत्त्ववेत्ता) • **Example:** The archaeologist studied the ruins of an ancient temple to understand the civilization's culture. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (Archaeologist)**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Archivist** (पुरालेखपाल): A person responsible for collecting, managing, and maintaining historical documents and archives. • **Example:** The archivist organized the ancient manuscripts in chronological order. • **Anthropologist** (मानवविज्ञानी): A person who studies human societies, cultures, and their development. • **Example:** The anthropologist studied the customs and rituals of indigenous tribes. • **Historian** (इतिहासकार): A person who studies or writes about history. • **Example:** The historian published a detailed account of the medieval period. 34:Ta2f, The correct answer is: **Taciturn**.
